Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
This is some relevant card text of Anima Gathering. The capitalization
is mine:

[aus] Put this card on this acting vampire and choose another
minion you control. Burn this card IF THIS MINION UNTAPS. During your
untap phase, +you may choose not to untap this minion as normal. The
chosen minion gets +2 intercept.

So here is the contrived situation:

Isabel de Leon plays Anima Gathering, to boost Anneke.
Anneke calls Banishment, declaring Isabel, and it passes.
I re-influence Isabel, and she is untapped (since the uncontrolled
region does not save "tapped" state).

So Isabel is untapped, with Anima Gathering on her, without "untapping".

* Does she get to keep the Anima Gathering?

* Can she play another one?

Thanks.
